channel.description: Find the right tool at the right price.

item.title: Weber 4-Burner Propane Griddle for $400 with Free Shipping
item.description: This Weber outdoor griddle features four burners and runs on liquid propane. The current price is $400 with free shipping, which is $49.99 off the typical price.

item.title: Traeger Ridgeline XL Pellet Grill $899.99 at Costco
item.description: The Traeger Ridgeline XL is a pellet grill with electronic auto-start ignition. Costco is offering it for $899.99, which is $100 off the regular price. The savings are valid from August 27 through September 9, while supplies last.

item.title: Weber Kettle Grill Cover with Storage Bag Drops to $34.29
item.description: This Weber grill cover is designed for 22- and 22.5-inch kettle-style grills. It is made of durable polyester fabric and includes a storage bag. The cover is available for $34.29 with free shipping for Prime members, but the deal ends in one day.

item.title: Bristle-free grill brush scrubber for griddles and cast iron, $9.99
item.description: The Yukon Glory Grill Brush Scrubber is a bristle-free cleaning tool designed for griddles, grills, and cast iron cookware. It is priced at $9.99 with free shipping for Amazon Prime members.

item.title: Cuisinart Steam Cleaner Grill Brush for $12.99 at Woot
item.description: This Cuisinart grill brush uses steam to clean grates without chemicals. It features an easy-fill handle and a flow control knob on the brush head. The deal is available at Woot for $12.99 with free shipping for Prime members.

item.title: DEWALT 20V GRABO Vacuum Lifter Drops to $179
item.description: The DEWALT 20V MAX GRABO Lifter is a cordless vacuum lifter designed to grab and lift construction materials like panels, pavers, and flooring. It has a load capacity of 265 pounds and is being offered as a tool-only purchase. The price is $179, which is $20 less than a previous deal from Lowe's.

item.title: iKumar 41-Piece Crochet Hooks Set with Case for $7.19
item.description: This set includes 41 crochet hooks in various sizes, stored in a convenient case. The price drops to $7.19 after applying a coupon code at checkout, down from $11.99.

item.title: Backyard Discovery Santa Maria XL Wood Fire & Charcoal Grill for $2499
item.description: The Backyard Discovery Argentine Santa Maria XL is a wood fire and charcoal grill designed for authentic gaucho-style open-fire cooking. It includes an asado clamp and is currently available for $2499 at Sam's Club.

item.title: Amazon Silicone Griddle Tools Mat 2-Pack for $10
item.description: This 2-pack of silicone griddle tools mats is designed for Blackstone griddles and other BBQ grills, providing a heat-resistant surface to rest utensils. The deal offers the set at $10, with free shipping on orders of $25 or more.

item.title: Harbor Freight ICON Buy More, Save More Event
item.description: Harbor Freight is running a Buy More, Save More promotion on ICON hand tools, creepers, lighting, shop tools, and seats from August 31 through September 13. Discounts scale with quantity purchased: buy two items for 15% off, buy three for more savings.

item.title: ANNKE 2K Smart Door Lock with Palm Vein, App, Voice, Code & Key Entry for $99.99
item.description: The ANNKE 2K Smart Door Lock offers multiple entry methods including palm vein recognition, app control, voice commands, codes, and a physical key. It features a 10,000mAh battery and is available for $99.99 with free shipping using code Q8Y91NHWNG2Y at checkout.

item.title: Grand Patio 108-Gallon Deck Storage Box for $130
item.description: This Grand Patio deck storage box offers 108 gallons of space for patio cushions, garden tools, and pool accessories. It features a wicker design and hydraulic lift for easy access. The box is available for $129.99 with free shipping.

item.title: Costway 2-Layer Wood-Fired Pizza Oven with Cover for $96.70 at Walmart
item.description: This Costway pizza oven features two cooking layers and a waterproof cover, designed for outdoor use. It is available at Walmart for $96.70 with free shipping.

item.title: DeWalt Drills, Saws, and More Up to 63% Off at Amazon
item.description: Amazon is offering clearance-level discounts on a range of DeWalt tools, including drills, saws, sanders, batteries, mechanic's tools, and accessories. Savings reach up to 63% off, with prices starting at just $3.39.

item.title: Home Depot Labor Day Sale: Outdoor Power Tools Up to 30% Off
item.description: Home Depot's Labor Day sale includes discounts up to 30% on outdoor power tools from brands like DeWalt, Ryobi, Milwaukee, and Makita. Leaf blowers, chainsaws, hedge trimmers, and mowers are marked down for fall cleanup.

item.title: Kamado Joe Classic Joe Series II Grill and Smoker with Cart and Shelves for $1,014.98
item.description: This Kamado Joe Classic Joe Series II is an 18-inch ceramic charcoal grill and smoker that comes with a cart and side shelves. The deal price is $1,014.98 as listed on Amazon.

item.title: Traeger Grill Cover for Pro 575 and Pro 22 at $13.99
item.description: This grill cover fits Traeger Pro 575 and Pro 22 models. It is currently available for $13.99 with free Prime shipping, and some accounts can save an additional $0.70 by clipping a coupon.

item.title: Klein Tools MODbox Half-Width Organizer with 10 Compartments for $29.98
item.description: The Klein Tools MODbox Half-Width Tall Compartment Tool Organizer features 10 compartments for storing and organizing tools. It is currently available for $29.98 with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: Mueller 14-Inch Portable Charcoal Grill for $17.99
item.description: The Mueller BBQ Buddy is a compact 14-inch portable charcoal grill, suitable for tailgating, camping, or small outdoor spaces. It is currently available for $17.99 with free shipping for Amazon Prime members.

item.title: Milwaukee M12 Pruner Shears Kit with Batteries and Charger for $449
item.description: This kit includes the M12 cordless brushless pruner shears, a 2.0 Ah battery, charger, M12 HATCHET, and three M12 HO 5.0 Ah batteries. It offers up to 1,000 cuts per charge on half-inch branches and is compatible with the M12 system. The deal is available for ship to store and delivery.

item.title: Kings County Tools 8" Pull Saw for $16.47 at Lowe's
item.description: This angled Japanese pull hand saw features a serrated blade for efficient cutting. It is available for $16.47 at Lowe's, with free store pickup where available or free shipping on orders over $35.

item.title: RYOBI 18V Cordless Edger Drops to $49.50 at Home Depot
item.description: The RYOBI ONE+ 18V cordless edger is available for $49.50 at Home Depot, a clearance price that may vary by location. This tool-only deal requires in-store pickup where available.

item.title: Pit Boss BBQ Meat Claws on sale for $11.24
item.description: These Pit Boss BBQ Meat Claws feature sharp stainless-steel construction and heat-resistant handles. They are currently available for $11.24 with free shipping for Prime members.

item.title: PULITUO 199-Piece Cordless Drill Set with 2 Batteries, Charger & Toolbox for $49.99
item.description: This set includes a 20V cordless drill, 2 batteries, a charger, and a toolbox, along with 199 pieces of accessories. It is available in green or pink for $49.99 after a 50% discount with promo code TSPIXCPT, plus free shipping.

item.title: AstroAI Digital Tire Pressure Gauge with Braided Hose Drops to $19.99
item.description: This digital tire pressure gauge from AstroAI measures up to 250 PSI and includes a stainless braided hose for durability. The deal brings the price down to $19.99 with a promo code at Amazon.

item.title: 28-Inch Barrel Charcoal Grill with Wood Shelves for $104
item.description: This 28-inch barrel charcoal grill features wood shelves and offers 626 square inches of cooking space. The final price is $104.40 after an extra 10% off the sale price of $115.99, applied at checkout.

item.title: Kamado Joe Big Joe 3 charcoal grill now $2,199 at Sam's Club
item.description: The Kamado Joe Big Joe 3 is a large ceramic charcoal grill designed for outdoor cooking. This deal offers the grill at $2,199, which is notably lower than typical Black Friday pricing of around $2,500.

item.title: Pit Boss Lexington 500 Pellet Smoker at Walmart for $346
item.description: The Pit Boss Lexington 500 is a wood-fired pellet grill with 543 square inches of cooking space. Walmart offers it for $346 with free shipping.

item.title: KingChii 3-Burner Propane Griddle Drops to $174.73 at Walmart
item.description: This KingChii 3-burner propane griddle features a 27-inch flat top cooking surface, ideal for camping, tailgating, and backyard parties. It is currently available at Walmart for $174.73 with free shipping.

item.title: ThermoPro TP08 Dual Probe Wireless Meat Thermometer for $18.58 at Walmart
item.description: The ThermoPro TP08 is a wireless remote cooking thermometer with dual probes, designed for use with BBQ smokers, grills, and ovens. It monitors food temperature from up to 300 feet away. This deal offers it at $18.58 at Walmart.com.
